elements.description:
A conversation that forks when a past message is edited: a "‹ 2 / 3 ›" switcher on each message with siblings, and
the picked branch's messages below it.

properties.name: messages
properties.description: Every message of every branch, in the order they were written; each names its parent

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The picked child per parent id ("" for the first messages); a parent without an entry shows its newest child

properties.name: editable
properties.description: Your messages can be edited (default true; editable="false" turns it off)

properties.name: replyActions
properties.description: The actions under each reply (message-actions' keys); an empty list hides the bar

properties.name: renderContent
properties.description: Draws a message's content – a Node or a string. Default: the text, a paragraph per blank line

properties.name: caption
properties.description: The caption line (Standard: on the tray, Clean: the card's last row); unset, it sums up the branches

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A branch was picked in a switcher, or a new branch was made; detail `{ selected, messageId, index, count }`. Cancelable: prevent it to control `selected`

events.name: tc-messages-change
events.description: Messages were added (a new branch, its replies); detail `{ messages: BranchMessage[] }`. Cancelable: prevent it to control `messages`

events.name: tc-edit
events.description: Send was pressed on an edited message; detail `{ messageId, text, message, respondWith }`. Cancelable: prevent it to drop the edit. Call `respondWith(replies | promise)` to answer the new branch

props.name: messages
props.description: Every message of every branch. Controlled when defined; otherwise the element keeps them, starting at `defaultMessages`

props.name: defaultMessages
props.description: The messages at first when uncontrolled

props.name: onMessagesChange
props.description: Called with the whole list when messages are added (a new branch, its replies)

props.name: selected
props.description: The picked child per parent id ("" for the first messages). Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The picked branches at first when uncontrolled – unset shows the newest child at every fork

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.type: (selected: BranchSelection, change: { messageId: string; index: number; count: number }) => void
props.description: Called when a branch is picked, or a new branch was made

props.name: onEdit
props.description:
Called when an edited message is sent. Return the new branch's replies (or a promise of them) to answer it;
return false to drop the edit

changelog: `tc-conversation-branches` – edit a past message to fork the conversation; a 2 / 3 switcher on the edited message, each branch's replies (with `tc-message-actions`) below, and `tc-edit` answered with the new replies or a promise of them.
